about.statement: I design calm, considered products at the intersection of editorial craft and emerging technology — turning ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel inevitable.
about.bio.0: My experience spans urban planning and design, strategic research, and AI product growth. My interdisciplinary education allows me to move fluidly across research, systems thinking, data analysis, visual communication, and project execution.
about.focus.value: AI Product Marketing & GTM；Global Content & Growth；Product Operations；Culturally Aware Communication
work.introduction: A selection of professional experiences, AI product experiments, and research projects across product growth, global communication, and data-driven strategy.
work.internship.0.overview: Working across product marketing, global content, and growth for an AI app-building platform. I translate product capabilities into use cases, launch narratives, demos, tutorials, and multi-channel campaigns for global users.
work.internship.0.contribution.0: Managed content planning and distribution across X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Forum, Changelog, and other owned channels, building a content matrix spanning 13 channels. Produced and distributed 230+ cross-platform content pieces and 50+ video assets, generating at least 3.8M+ impressions/views through organic distribution and campaigns. Contributed to 15.9% follower growth on the main X account and 148% growth on Instagram.
work.internship.0.contribution.1: Supported 17+ product launches and feature updates across Agent Builder, AI Skills, Templates, Marketplace, Multi-Session, and new model releases. Translated product capabilities into launch messaging and assets across Blog, Changelog, social media, tutorials, TVCs, ads, and in-product communications. The Agent Builder campaign generated 367K impressions, 74K views, and 32.3K website visits, with the best-performing campaign reaching approximately $0.0035 per website visit.
work.internship.0.contribution.2: Built or iterated 9+ interactive Web Prototypes / Demos using AI-assisted development workflows, covering Business Dashboards, Marketplace experiences, Toybox concepts, visual interaction experiments, and Agent Builder use cases. Transformed prototypes into product demos, tutorials, use cases, and marketing assets, connecting product concept validation with user-facing communication.
work.internship.0.contribution.3: Sourced, reviewed, or coordinated with 10+ international creators, supporting 8+ creator collaborations and 12+ repost/co-created content pieces across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok. Three key Instagram creator collaborations generated 799 total interactions.
work.internship.1.overview: Conducted market research and structured business analysis for AI consulting projects, translating complex market and operational information into decision-ready insights and internal collaboration systems.
work.internship.1.contribution.0: Contributed extensively to a smart wearable industry research project, conducting multidimensional analysis of market performance, feature matrices, and user feedback across 5+ core competitors. Produced a 20,000+ Chinese-character trend insight report to support structured business decision-making.
work.internship.1.contribution.1: Addressed internal information gaps by restructuring and improving 6 team collaboration SOPs, increasing information retrieval and project collaboration efficiency by approximately 20%.
work.internship.1.contribution.2: Contributed extensively to 4 phased presentation decks for major clients, restructuring the information architecture and visual communication logic of complex business information to reduce communication costs and improve client satisfaction.
work.internship.2.overview: Combined content strategy, AI-assisted analysis, and workflow optimization to improve campaign performance and establish a more repeatable content production system.
work.internship.2.contribution.0: Led end-to-end planning and execution of content campaigns across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, and other platforms, coordinating topics, scripts, and publishing cadence. Produced 10+ breakout videos exceeding 100K views and drove 180% follower growth for a core account within one month.
work.internship.2.contribution.1: Used Python and AI tools to analyze 100+ high-performing content pieces and creator accounts, identifying patterns in headline structures, topic pacing, and engagement mechanisms. Synthesized distribution patterns across different content styles to support content planning and potential creator selection.
work.internship.2.contribution.2: Restructured the team's internal video production and publishing workflow and established standardized SOPs. Introduced productivity tools and template-based processes, reducing the production and delivery cycle per video to one-third of its original length and significantly improving cross-functional collaboration efficiency.
work.internship.2.contribution.3: Rebuilt the video production SOP through templates and efficiency tools, reducing the production and delivery cycle to one-third of its previous length.
work.internship.3.overview: Participated in the zero-to-one development of domestic and global social media account systems, connecting content distribution, creator analysis, and conversion-path testing.
work.internship.3.contribution.0: Contributed extensively to building an account matrix from 0 to 1 across overseas communities (Reddit) and Chinese social platforms (Xiaohongshu/Douyin). Led the design of content acquisition and direct-message conversion funnels, generating 100K+ cumulative brand exposure and improving the overall conversion rate by 120%.
work.internship.3.contribution.1: Continuously monitored account performance, audience profiles, and content engagement data using Huitun Data and other platforms. Supported the selection of high-performing accounts and evaluated their content styles, audience fit, and distribution potential, translating creator potential and account data into reusable account development recommendations.
work.internship.3.contribution.2: Independently designed and executed an A/B test for content distribution strategies. Through multiple rounds of testing over 2 weeks, effectively mitigated platform traffic-limiting risks and improved account content distribution efficiency by 40%.
work.internship.4.overview: Design operations internship at Jinqiao Group.
work.internship.4.contribution.0: Led a case study of the Canary Wharf waterfront area in London, producing a 12,000-word case study that was adapted into corporate WeChat content, with the section receiving 1,500+ reads.
work.internship.4.contribution.1: Participated in 10+ design and proposal review meetings involving design teams and the group, responsible for meeting documentation and textual analysis of meeting minutes to support the identification of concentrated areas of demand.
work.project.a01.summary: An interactive globe-based planning tool that helps international football fans convert match times, compare time zones, and build a personal viewing schedule.
work.project.a01.description: The project started from a global user problem: match schedules are usually published in one fixed time zone, while viewers need to plan around local routines. I designed a 3D globe as the primary interaction, allowing users to select a location directly, view local match times, and organize selected games into a personal schedule.
work.project.a02.summary: A live vertical showcase that presents real Enter templates as continuously scrolling and interactive previews.
work.project.a02.description: The page embeds twelve real product templates as scaled live previews rather than static screenshots. Templates continuously scroll upward, pause and enlarge slightly on hover, and open in full-screen view when selected. The interface was designed in a 9:16 format for both product discovery and short-form video recording.
work.project.a03.summary: A browser-based interactive interpretation of a machine-learning research concept, designed to make pattern growth, damage, and regeneration visually understandable.
work.project.a03.description: The project translates Growing Neural Cellular Automata from a technical research topic into an accessible interactive experience. Users can observe the growth process, disturb the generated structure, and explore how local cellular rules produce complex and regenerative behavior.
work.project.b01.summary: A structured content-planning framework developed from the analysis of more than 100 high-performing posts and creator accounts.
work.project.b01.description: I combined Python-based data organization with AI-assisted qualitative analysis to identify patterns in hooks, topic selection, pacing, visual structure, and engagement mechanisms. The findings were converted into reusable criteria for campaign planning, content evaluation, and creator selection.
work.project.b02.summary: An ongoing comparative study of AI app-building and developer products, focusing on product positioning, onboarding, use-case communication, and launch strategy.
work.project.b02.description: Compared products including Lovable, Base44, Claude, Vercel, Bolt, and Replit across product narratives, feature structures, user journeys, community content, and launch communication. Findings were used to support Enter Pro’s use-case selection, product messaging, content priorities, and campaign planning.
work.project.b03.summary: A structured data system that standardizes heterogeneous urban datasets and automates large-scale data cleaning and integration.
work.project.b03.description: Designed unified field standards and coding rules for more than 20 types of urban data, including population, POI, and industry datasets. Developed Python and Excel workflows to process more than 500 source tables and over two million records, reducing one processing cycle from three days to approximately four hours.
